title: AS5600 encoder mount
summary: Holds an AS5600 magnetic encoder board under a magnet on a spindle tip. Corner lips locate the board by its outline, because the magnet axis must sit within 0.25 of the IC and the holes can't hold that. Four posts with stainless M2.5 screws up from below clamp it. The post height is worked out from the magnet's face.

views.label: Board under the magnet
views.caption: 23 mm board on 5.15 posts, as in the controller base: a 6 × 1 magnet on a spindle tip 11 above the floor, 1.5 above the IC. Drag the slider to bring the magnet down to its place. The four corner lips locate the board; the screws only clamp it.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four mounts on one strip of floor, lips 0.05 to 0.25 per side off the board, marked with 1 to 4 dots between the front posts. Low posts to save plastic; a slot through each floor for header pins.

specs.title: The board
specs.badgeNote: DollaTek / JYUDAUFU, 21 Oct 2026; magnet thickness CAL

specs.title: The mount
rows: 1.6 wall, 5 legs, 1.0 above the PCB underside
M2.5 stainless up from below, washer and nut on top
specs.note: Every 0.1 of gap lets the board shift 0.1 off the magnet axis: keep it well under 0.25.
specs.badgeNote: the lip gap is set by the fit piece

checks: Does the board drop in square without forcing?
Once in, can you feel it shift side to side?
Screw one down: do the heads sit flush underneath, and does the clamp leave it flat?
Does it come out again without prying the lips?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, in the enclosure's material. M2.5 × 8 stainless, washer and nut to test one.
